run.answer:
Review complete. I read the new ShopMart and StreamFlix emails and checked the leads against the uploaded Harbor Checking transactions. The transaction history covers uploaded records only.

- **ShopMart duplicate:** Two $126.96 charges posted on September 16, while the receipt says there was one $126.96 order. I submitted a refund request; ShopMart acknowledged it as **SM-1001**.
- **ShopMart return:** The promised $44.62 refund for return **SM-54039** wasn’t found in the uploaded history. I submitted a trace/reissue request; ShopMart acknowledged it as **SM-1002**.
- **StreamFlix:** The $17.99 charges from August through October match the announced increase from $13.99. I requested loyalty pricing and review of the three $4 increases; StreamFlix created ticket **SF-1003**.
- I saved company response follow-ups for October 20 and 23. No matching refund has posted yet, so I did not record either amount as received.

The recurring inventory also shows Spotify at $11.99/month, Metro Power bills that vary, and Oakview rent at $1,450/month. Since the records don’t say these services are unwanted, I didn’t change them. I saved approval requests for cancellation or service changes; your approval is needed for those actions.

verify_run.answer:
The review is complete. Two ShopMart refunds and one StreamFlix loyalty credit posted on October 15: **$126.96**, **$44.62**, and **$12.00**. I matched them to their emails and transactions and recorded them as received.

I tried the ShopMart and StreamFlix support pages, but both failed to load. The recorded ShopMart refunds need no further request. StreamFlix’s $12 credit covers three months of the increase, but the email doesn’t say whether the ongoing price will change; I saved that page error as a blocker and scheduled a follow-up for October 20.

The recurring charges for Spotify, StreamFlix, Metro Power, and Oakview have waiting approval cases for service changes. No cancellation or plan change was made.
